시술 후 선크림은 언제부터 바르나요?: When can I start applying sunscreen after a procedure?
시술 종류에 따라 다릅니다. 피부 표면이 열리지 않는 레이저 토닝·IPL: It depends on the procedure. After laser toning, IPL, or lifting, which leave the skin surface intact, you can usually apply it the same day. After procedures that leave tiny channels in the skin, usually after 24 hours. After procedures that leave scabs, once the wound has healed. If your clinic's instructions differ, follow your clinic.
시술 후 세안은 언제부터 클렌징 밀크로 하나요?: When can I start using the cleansing milk after a procedure?
병원이 세안을 허락한 시점부터 씁니다. 레이저 토닝·IPL·리프팅은 보통: Start once your clinic says you may wash your face. After laser toning, IPL, or lifting, you can usually wash gently with lukewarm water from the evening of the same day. After injections, use it without massaging once the time advised by your clinic has passed.
주사 시술(보톡스·필러·스킨부스터) 후에도 롤링 마사지를 해도 되나요?: Can I do the rolling massage after injections (Botox, fillers, skin boosters)?
아니요. 주사 부위를 문지르거나 누르면 약물이나 필러가 퍼질 수 있어,: No. Rubbing or pressing the injection site may cause the product or filler to spread, so clinics advise avoiding massage. After injections, spread the cleansing milk lightly with your palms and rinse right away.
점을 뺀 자리에 선크림을 발라도 되나요?: Can I apply sunscreen where a mole was removed?
상처가 아물기 전에는 바르지 마세요. 두 제품 모두 표시사항에 '상처가: Do not apply it until the wound has healed. The labels of both products say, “Avoid use on areas with wounds.” While the wound is taped, apply only to the skin around it, and once it has healed, apply carefully over the treated area as well.
피부과에서 무기자차를 쓰라고 했어요. 뉴베리프 선크림을 써도 되나요?: My dermatologist told me to use a mineral sunscreen. Can I use the NEUVELIF sunscreen?
의료진의 안내를 따르세요. 뉴베리프 백합 리커버리 선크림은 유기자차입니다: Please follow your doctor's advice. NEUVELIF Backhap Recovery Sunscreen uses chemical (organic) filters. Some clinics recommend a mineral sunscreen for a while after procedures that leave tiny channels in the skin.
광역동치료(PDT) 후에는 선크림만 바르면 되나요?: After photodynamic therapy (PDT), is sunscreen alone enough?
아니요. 치료 후 약 48시간은 피부가 빛에 매우 예민해 선크림만으로는: No. For about 48 hours after treatment your skin is extremely sensitive to light, and sunscreen alone cannot protect it. Stay indoors during this time, and apply sunscreen every day from 48 hours onward.
시술 전에도 써야 하나요?: Should I use sunscreen before a procedure too?
네. 그을린 피부는 시술 뒤 색소침착 위험이 높아, 시술 전부터 자외선을: Yes. Tanned skin has a higher risk of pigmentation after procedures, so many doctors advise avoiding UV exposure even before the procedure. Many clinics also ask you to arrive without makeup or sunscreen on the day, which makes the cleansing milk a good choice that morning.
시술 후 붓기도 클렌징 밀크로 빠지나요?: Will the cleansing milk reduce swelling after a procedure?
시술로 생긴 부기를 줄인다고 말할 수 없습니다. 클렌징 밀크의 붓기 완화: We cannot say that it reduces swelling caused by a procedure. The cleansing milk's depuffing test was measured on untreated skin right after a single wash. Manage post-procedure swelling as your clinic advises.
유기자차인가요, 무기자차인가요?: Is it a chemical or a mineral sunscreen?

자외선 차단 효과는 시험했나요?: Has its UV protection been tested?

네. 자외선 차단, 미백, 주름개선 3중 기능성 화장품으로 2025년 6: Yes. It was reported to Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) in June 2025 as a triple-function cosmetic for UV protection, brightening, and wrinkle improvement. The brightening ingredient is niacinamide and the anti-wrinkle ingredient is adenosine.
눈시림이 적도록 만든 제품이지만, 느끼는 정도는 사람마다 다릅니다. 평소: It was made to minimize eye stinging, but sensitivity varies from person to person. After 21 women who usually feel eye stinging with cosmetics used it for 2 weeks, their eye stinging score fell by 80.27%. If it gets directly into your eyes, rinse with water.
민감한 피부도 쓸 수 있나요?: Can people with sensitive skin use it?
24시간 첩포 시험(34명)에서 피부 자극도 0.00으로 무자극 판정을: In a 24-hour patch test (34 participants) it scored 0.00 for skin irritation and was classified as non-irritating. Skin reactions vary, though, so try it first on a small area such as behind the ear or along the jawline. If you notice any problem, stop using it and consult a dermatologist.
지성 피부도 괜찮나요?: Is it okay for oily skin?
촉촉한 로션 제형이라 지성 피부나 더운 날에는 유분감을 느낄 수 있습니다: It is a moist lotion texture, so oily skin or hot days may feel a little greasy. In Hwahae reviews, “moisturizing” is the most common comment, though some say it feels heavy on oily skin. Apply thin layers in two passes and add powder on top if needed.
화해 리뷰에서 가장 많이 언급된 장점이 '촉촉함'입니다. 에어컨 아래처럼: “Moisturizing” is the most frequently mentioned strength in Hwahae reviews. In dry environments, such as under air conditioning, apply a moisturizer first.
백탁이 있나요?: Does it leave a white cast?
거의 없습니다. 사용 직후 설문에서 22명 중 21명(95.5%)이 백탁: Hardly at all. In a survey right after use, 21 of 22 participants (95.5%) said it finished clean with no white cast. Applying a lot at once can make it sit on the skin, so apply it in two passes.
메이크업 전에 써도 되나요? 밀림은 없나요?: Can I use it before makeup? Does it pill?
Apply it as the last step of your skincare and put on base makeup once it has absorbed. In the survey, all 22 participants said it layered with other products without pilling, but it may pill if you apply a lot or layer immediately.
얼굴 전체가 충분히 덮일 만큼 바르세요. 자외선 차단지수는 피부 1cm²: Apply enough to cover your whole face. SPF is measured with 2 mg of product per 1 cm² of skin. A thinner layer may not give the labeled protection, so we recommend applying it in two passes.
네. 외출 30분 전에 바르고, 2~3시간 간격으로 덧바르세요. 땀을 많: Yes. Apply 30 minutes before going outdoors and reapply every 2–3 hours. Also reapply after sweating heavily or towel drying.
톤업 효과가 있나요?: Does it have a tone-up effect?
아니요. 색을 입히는 톤업 성분은 들어 있지 않습니다. '미백 기능성'은: No. It contains no tinting tone-up ingredients. “Brightening function” means it helps brighten the skin with continued use, which is different from a tone-up that makes skin look brighter immediately.
선크림은 어떻게 지우나요?: How do I remove the sunscreen?
클렌징 밀크나 평소 쓰는 세안제로 지우세요. 선크림 위에 메이크업을 했다: Remove it with the cleansing milk or your usual cleanser. If you wore makeup over it, remove with the cleansing milk first and then wash your face.
향료는 넣지 않았습니다. 다만 원료 자체의 냄새가 약하게 날 수 있어,: No fragrance is added. The raw materials may have a faint natural scent, so Hwahae reviews include both “almost no scent” and “it has a slight distinctive smell.”
네. 전성분 42가지 중 32번째에 에탄올이 들어 있습니다. 에탄올에 민: Yes. Ethanol is the 32nd of 42 ingredients. If you are sensitive to ethanol, try it on a small area first.
얼굴 말고 몸에도 써도 되나요?: Can I use it on my body as well as my face?
네. 사용방법에도 얼굴과 목 등 자외선에 노출되는 부위에 바르도록 안내하: Yes. The directions also say to apply it to the face, neck, and other areas exposed to UV rays.
네. 성별과 관계없이 쓸 수 있습니다. 인체적용시험에도 남성 참여자가 포: Yes, anyone can use it. Male participants were included in the clinical testing (UV protection test).
이 제품은 어린이용으로 시험하거나 표시한 제품이 아닙니다. 어린이에게는: This product has not been tested or labeled for children. For children, we recommend a sunscreen labeled for children.
임신 중에도 쓸 수 있나요?: Can I use it during pregnancy?
임신 중 사용에 대해서는 따로 시험하지 않았습니다. 전성분을 담당 의료진: It has not been specifically tested for use during pregnancy. Please review the full ingredient list with your healthcare provider before use.
여드름이 잘 나는 피부도 괜찮나요?: Is it okay for acne-prone skin?
여드름성 피부 사용 적합성 시험(논코메도제닉 등)은 하지 않았습니다. 화: We have not run suitability tests for acne-prone skin (such as non-comedogenic testing). Many Hwahae reviews report no breakouts, but some reviewers had minor breakouts. Watch how your skin reacts when you first use it.
파란 튜브와 흰 튜브는 어떤 차이가 있나요?: What is the difference between the blue tube and the white tube?
내용물은 같고 용기 디자인만 바뀌었습니다. 사용하면서 불편하다는 의견이: The formula is the same; only the packaging design changed. We improved the container after many users found the old one inconvenient.
A lot comes out when I first open it.
묽은 로션 제형이라 세게 누르면 한 번에 많이 나올 수 있습니다. 튜브를: It is a light lotion texture, so pressing hard can push out a lot at once. Squeeze the tube gently to control the amount.
제조일로부터 36개월, 개봉 후에는 12개월 안에 쓰세요. 용기에 표시된: Use within 36 months of manufacture and within 12 months of opening. If the expiration date printed on the container comes first, use it only until that date.
2025 하반기 화해 어워드 선케어 부문(선크림/로션) 진정 카테고리에서: It won No. 1 in the Soothing category of the Sun Care (Sunscreen/Lotion) section at the 2025 H2 Hwahae Awards. The Hwahae Awards are selected based on consumer review and rating data.
마른 손에 적당량을 덜어 마른 얼굴에 펴 바르고, 손끝으로 얼굴 안쪽에서: Dispense an appropriate amount onto dry hands and spread it over a dry face. With your fingertips, massage in light rolling motions from the center of the face outward and from bottom to top, then rinse thoroughly with water. Finishing with a light splash of cold water may help relieve temporary puffiness.

한 번에 3~4번 펌핑해 얼굴 전체에 펴 바르세요. 짙은 메이크업을 지울: Use 3–4 pumps at a time and spread over your whole face. You can use a little more when removing heavy makeup.

선크림과 가벼운 메이크업은 클렌징 밀크 한 번으로 지울 수 있습니다. 짙: Sunscreen and light makeup come off with one wash of the cleansing milk. If you wore heavy makeup or waterproof products, remove them first with a dedicated remover or wash once more after the cleansing milk.
한 번에 완전히 지우기는 어렵습니다. 화해 리뷰에서도 가장 많이 나온 아: It is hard to remove completely in one go. This is also the most common drawback mentioned in Hwahae reviews. Remove waterproof eye and lip makeup first with a point makeup remover.
정상입니다. 거품을 내지 않고 펴 발라 메이크업과 노폐물을 녹여 내는 밀: That is normal. It is a milk-type cleanser that you spread on without foaming to dissolve makeup and impurities. It contains mild cleansing ingredients such as decyl glucoside.
My skin still feels slippery after rinsing.
보습 성분이 피부에 남으며 나는 느낌일 수 있습니다. 미온수로 충분히 헹: That may be the moisturizing ingredients remaining on your skin. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. If you prefer a squeaky-clean finish, you can wash again with a gentle foam cleanser.
I don't really notice the depuffing effect.
붓기 완화는 일시적인 효과이고, 느끼는 정도는 사람마다 다릅니다. 한국피: The depuffing effect is temporary, and how much you notice it varies from person to person. Try finishing with a cold-water rinse as well.
